purpose.en: Build your glutes by lifting your hips on one leg.

text.zh: 一条腿伸直抬起，用臀部把髋推高
text.en: Lift one leg straight and drive your hips up with your glutes
Keep the standing foot planted and your hips level.

text.zh: 慢慢放回，别用腰往上顶。
text.en: Lower slowly and do not push up with your lower back.

commonErrors.en: Letting the hips tilt or twist as you lift.
Arching the lower back instead of using your glutes.

cautions.zh: 腰不舒服时抬低一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your lower back feels uncomfortable, lift lower, and stop if it still hurts.

cautions.zh: 头和肩放在垫子上，别用脖子撑
cautions.en: Keep your head and shoulders on the mat and do not push through your neck.
